description: This PHP file contains utility functions used in the SuiteCRM Upgrade Wizard, handling version manipulations, file backups, copying, deletion, cache management, permission checks, logging, and upgrade process management.

methods.name: implodeVersion
methods.description: Concatenates parts of a version string after removing beta/rc suffixes, supporting delimiters and custom last symbol.

methods.name: getUploadRelativeName
methods.description: Resolves upload:// paths to real filesystem paths using UploadFile class if available.

methods.name: commitMakeBackupFiles
methods.description: Backs up files targeted for upgrade by copying them to a restore directory, skipping md5 files.

methods.name: commitCopyNewFiles
methods.description: Copies new patch files from unzipped directory to the application directories, handling special conditions.

methods.name: copyFilesOnCancel
methods.description: Placeholder for function to revert or handle canceled upgrades.

methods.name: removeFileFromPath
methods.description: Removes specified file(s) from a directory recursively, with optional excluded files.

methods.name: copyRecursiveBetweenDirectories
methods.description: Recursively copies all files from one directory to another.

methods.name: deleteDirectory
methods.description: Deletes a directory and its contents, with option to only empty it.

methods.name: deleteAndOverWriteSelectedFiles
methods.description: Deletes specified directories and copies over updated files, tracking copied and skipped files.

methods.name: recursive_empty_or_remove_directory
methods.description: Recursively empties or removes a directory with exclusion options.

methods.name: deleteCache
methods.description: Deletes cached module files, jsLanguage, smarty cache, and rebuilds dashlet cache.

methods.name: deleteChance
methods.description: Removes a specific template directory related to 'chance'.

methods.name: upgradeUWFiles
methods.description: Copies upgrade wizard files from an uploaded patch zip to their respective locations, handling customizations.

methods.name: checkCustomOverrides
methods.description: Checks for customized files that also exist in the upgrade package.

methods.name: upgradeUWFilesCopy
methods.description: Recursively copies an array of upgrade wizard files to their destinations.

methods.name: getValidPatchName
methods.description: Retrieves valid patch file names from the upload/upgrade/patch directory, selecting the newest.

methods.name: updateVersions
methods.description: Finalizes upgrade by updating the database version info and copying the new sugar_version.php.

methods.name: getModuleLanguagePack
methods.description: Loads module language strings from specified language files.

methods.name: checkSystemCompliance
methods.description: Checks server environment for compatibility with SuiteCRM 4.5+ requirements.

methods.name: isAutoOverwriteFile
methods.description: Determines if a file is automatically overwritten during upgrade.

methods.name: logThis
methods.description: Logs messages to the upgradeWizard.log file, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: updateQuickCreateDefs
methods.description: Creates or updates quickcreate view definitions to preserve customizations across upgrades.

methods.name: testPermsCreate
methods.description: Tests database privilege for CREATE TABLE.

methods.name: testPermsInsert
methods.description: Tests database privilege for INSERT.

methods.name: testPermsUpdate
methods.description: Tests database privilege for UPDATE.

methods.name: testPermsSelect
methods.description: Tests database privilege for SELECT.

methods.name: testPermsDelete
methods.description: Tests database privilege for DELETE.

methods.name: testPermsAlterTableAdd
methods.description: Tests privilege for ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN.

methods.name: testPermsAlterTableChange
methods.description: Tests privilege for ALTER TABLE CHANGE COLUMN.

methods.name: testPermsAlterTableDrop
methods.description: Tests privilege for ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN.

methods.name: testPermsDropTable
methods.description: Tests privilege for DROP TABLE.

methods.name: getFormattedError
methods.description: Formats an error message with the query that caused the error.

methods.name: getTableFromQuery
methods.description: Extracts the table name from an SQL query.

methods.name: preLicenseCheck
methods.description: Performs pre-upgrade checks, including unzipping files, validating the upgrade package, and environment checks.

methods.name: preflightCheck
methods.description: Performs environment and compatibility checks before upgrade, including verifying server settings and file permissions.

methods.name: upgradeUWFiles
methods.description: Copies upgrade wizard files from a patch zip during the upgrade process.

methods.name: commitCopyNewFiles
methods.description: Copies new patch files from unzipped directory to application directories, handling special conditions.

methods.name: upgradeUWFiles
methods.description: Copies upgrade wizard files from an uploaded patch zip during the upgrade process, handling customizations.

methods.name: upgradeTeamColumn
methods.description: Adds or updates the 'team_set_id' column on a given bean's table during an upgrade, ensuring proper dictionary definitions, indexes, and copying values from 'team_id'.

methods.name: upgradeFolderSubscriptionsTeamSetId
methods.description: Updates the 'team_set_id' field for folder subscriptions to align with team security standards.

methods.name: upgradeModulesForTeam
methods.description: Upgrades user and team associations, creating teams for users if necessary, and updating team-related fields during system upgrade.

methods.name: addNewSystemTabsFromUpgrade
methods.description: Detects new modules added in an upgrade and updates the system tabs accordingly.

methods.name: fix_dropdown_list
methods.description: Detects and fixes incorrectly named dropdown list entries, including updating language files, app_list_strings, and database references.

methods.name: update_iframe_dashlets
methods.description: Updates user preferences for dashlets, removing URLs related to obsolete SuiteCRM links.

methods.name: convertImageToText
methods.description: Deprecated method for converting image data to text in Microsoft SQL Server.

methods.name: clearHelpFiles
methods.description: Deletes all English inline help files to reset help documentation.

methods.name: upgradeDateTimeFields
methods.description: Updates date fields to include time zone information for calendar and call data.

methods.name: upgradeDocumentTypeFields
methods.description: Ensures 'doc_type' and 'type' fields are not null in documents and meetings tables, setting default values.

methods.name: merge_config_si_settings
methods.description: Merges settings from a 'config_si.php' file into 'config.php' during upgrade to preserve configuration.

methods.name: upgrade_connectors
methods.description: Supports upgrading connector configuration files, including deletion and metadata updates.

methods.name: remove_linkedin_config
methods.description: Removes LinkedIn connector configuration entries from metadata files during upgrade.

methods.name: remove_linkedin_connector
methods.description: Deletes LinkedIn connector source files from modules and external directories.

methods.name: upgradeEnableInsideViewConnector
methods.description: Activates the InsideView connector for specific modules during upgrade, loading mappings and configuration.

methods.name: repair_long_relationship_names
methods.description: Rebuilds relationship fields with long names (over 27 characters) to ensure proper database schema.

methods.name: removeSilentUpgradeVarsCache
methods.description: Deletes cached silent upgrade variables to force reload.

methods.name: loadSilentUpgradeVars
methods.description: Loads silent upgrade variables from cache file into memory.

methods.name: writeSilentUpgradeVars
methods.description: Saves silent upgrade variables to cache file.

methods.name: setSilentUpgradeVar
methods.description: Sets a variable in silent upgrade cache.

methods.name: getSilentUpgradeVar
methods.description: Retrieves a variable from silent upgrade cache.

methods.name: add_unified_search_to_custom_modules_vardefs
methods.description: Removes the cache for unified search module definitions to force regeneration.

methods.name: unlinkUpgradeFiles
methods.description: Cleans up upgrade files and runs custom upgrade removal scripts based on version comparison.

methods.name: getValidDBName
methods.description: Generates a database-safe name within length constraints by sanitizing and optionally ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: getUWDirs
methods.description: Provides paths to upgrade wizard directories, supporting different system configurations.

methods.name: whetherNeedToSkipDir
methods.description: Checks if a directory should be skipped based on a list of patterns.

methods.name: rebuildSprites
methods.description: Rebuilds CSS sprite images from theme directories, including custom themes for visual assets.

methods.name: repairSearchFields
methods.description: Fixes search field definitions and related metadata to ensure proper range searches.

methods.name: repairUpgradeHistoryTable
methods.description: Updates upgrade history entries to reflect new upload directory structures.
